Caline Caline DCP Dual Effects series browse by type volume/amplification amplification preamp / clean boost browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive overdrive browse by enclosure pedal Caline DCP-11 Andes - Overdrive/Boost Published on December 3, 2023 Caline DCP Dual Effects series boost / preamp overdrive pedal Information Caline Caline's DCP series is a line of dual pedals. 2 popular combo of effects in 1 unit for a very useful space saving feature. The Andes DCP-11 combines Caline's very popular Timmy inspired Pure Sky pedal with a boost pedal in front of it for maximum headroom and drive.
